schema.description: Resource schema for an Amazon ECS Task. This is a read-only resource representing a running or stopped task launched on an ECS cluster (e.g. via RunTask or StartTask).

Cluster.description: The short name or ARN of the cluster to list tasks from.
The short name or ARN of the cluster that hosts the task.

Cpu.description: The number of CPU units used by the task as expressed in the task definition.

CreatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp for the time when the task was created (entered the PENDING state).

DesiredStatus.description: The desired status of the task.

Group.description: The name of the task group associated with the task.

LastStatus.description: The last known status of the task.

LaunchType.description: The infrastructure on which the task runs.

Memory.description: The amount of memory (in MiB) used by the task as expressed in the task definition.

StartedBy.description: The tag specified when the task was started.

Tags.description: The metadata applied to the task.

TaskArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the task.

TaskDefinition.description: The ARN of the task definition that the task is based on.

TaskId.description: The unique identifier of the task (the final segment of the task ARN).
